notes.title: 🌟🎮💜💀 Global Update for aMAZE ZER0 💀💜🎮🌟
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33025983/58685daf06b3af36399702cedfc8b44f3512aed6.png

Hello dear players! Today we have prepared for you  global update for our game - aMAZE ZER0 !

https://store.steampowered.com/app/679660/aMAZE_ZER0/

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FAfOh5jUc-Q&ab_channel=BlenderGames


List of changes added to the game aMAZE ZER0:

-  Added support for XBOX One and XBOX 360 gamepads

-  Mazes have been visually improved at all levels
-  Visually improved destination at all levels  
-  Added player pointer in levels 
-  Improved ball movement (player)
-  Visually improved buttons throughout the game
-  New soundtrack added
-  Added social media buttons to the main menu
-  Added a button to turn on / off music at all levels
-  Added sound for all buttons in the game
-  Added exit button to the main menu from the menu of the selection of levels
- Improved previous achievements and replaced some with new ones
